reveal_barrier: EXP-0002 partial outcomes MUST NOT enter framework claims before sealed validation and formal release.

pillars.POSSIBILITY: what other biological states may be reachable
pillars.RESILIENCE: where the system fails and how life has solved equivalent failures elsewhere

genome_history_rule: Treat living genomes as a lossy, distributed, continuously rewritten evolutionary repository. Persistence does not prove present function; noncoding does not automatically mean junk.

local_first.rule: Canonical code, evidence, hashes, graph, and deterministic analyses remain locally owned. Cloud AI is optional and replaceable.

long_term_product: Mechanistically constrained AI Morph/Possibility/Resilience Engine with explicit observed-vs-inferred truth states.
